name: Forgemistress Balla
title: Mistress of the Grand Forge
examine: Shoulders that have argued with mithril and won. The forge quiets a little when she crosses it, out of respect.
lines: You're standing in the Grand Forge. Stand straighter.
Bretta Ironhewn keeps a forge at the ford now. Best rival I ever had. Tell her the anvil's still here — she'll know which one.
Silver is vanity, steel is policy, and starfall — starfall is a rumor I intend to hammer personally.
